latest_release.name: v2.11.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Bump rand from 0.9.2 to 0.9.4 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pkgxdev/pkgx/pull/1264
* Bump openssl from 0.10.72 to 0.10.78 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pkgxdev/pkgx/pull/1265
* Bump robinraju/release-downloader from 1.11 to 1.13 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pkgxdev/pkgx/pull/1266
* Bump openssl from 0.10.78 to 0.10.79 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pkgxdev/pkgx/pull/1268
* Bump openssl from 0.10.79 to 0.10.80 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pkgxdev/pkgx/pull/1270
* Bump actions/checkout from 6 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pkgxdev/pkgx/pull/1273
* restore the "fat" default docker image; publish a "slim" variant by @jhheider in https://github.com/pkgxdev/pkgx/pull/1275
* Allow multi-version openssl/abseil alongside unicode by @jhheider in https://github.com/pkgxdev/pkgx/pull/1278
* bump 2.11.0 // 0.9.0 by @jhheider in https://github.com/pkgxdev/pkgx/pull/1279


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pkgxdev/pkgx/compare/v2.10.3...v2.11.0
